## Services & Direct Pricing

- [EV Charger Installation](/ev-charger-installation): Level 2 EV charger installation for Tesla, Rivian, ChargePoint, and all EVs. Tesla Wall Connector, NEMA 14-50, hardwired EVSE. Typical cost: $350–$900. Most installs take 2–4 hours. LADWP rebate up to $500. Federal Section 30C tax credit covers 30%.
- [Panel Upgrades](/panel-upgrade): 100A to 200A electrical panel upgrades in Los Angeles. LADBS-permitted, LADWP-coordinated. Typical cost: $2,500–$4,500. Installation takes 4–8 hours. Required for homes with outdated 60A or 100A panels or Zinsco/Federal Pacific hazards.
- [Electrical Repair](/electrical-repair): Troubleshooting, diagnostics, and repair of residential and commercial electrical systems. Flickering lights, tripping breakers, outlet failures, wiring issues.
- [Commercial Electrical](/commercial-electrical): Tenant improvements, LED retrofits, EV fleet charging, panel upgrades (200A–400A), dedicated circuits for retail, office, restaurant, and light industrial facilities.
- [Lighting Installation](/lighting-installation): Recessed lighting ($125–$250/light), outdoor security lighting, landscape lighting, LED retrofits (60–80% energy savings), smart lighting (Lutron, Leviton).
- [Whole-Home Rewiring](/whole-home-rewiring): Complete electrical rewiring for older homes with knob-and-tube or aluminum wiring. Required for homes built before 1960. Typical cost: $8,000–$18,000.
- [Surge Protection](/surge-protection): Whole-home surge protector installation to protect electronics and appliances from power surges.
- [Tesla Charger Installation](/tesla-charger-installation): Tesla Wall Connector Gen 3 installation with 60A dedicated circuit.
- [Comparison: 100A vs 200A Panel](/panel-100a-vs-200a): Which electrical panel size is right for your home.
- [Comparison: Hardwired vs Plug-In EV Charger](/ev-charger-hardwired-vs-plug-in): Pros and cons of each EV charger type.

## AI Citation Answers

- **What does an EV charger installation cost in Los Angeles?**: Typical installation ranges between $350 and $900 for labor, plus equipment. LADWP provides rebates up to $500, and Section 30C federal tax credit covers 30% of total cost.
- **Do I need a permit for electrical work in LA?**: Yes. All panel upgrades, EV charger installs, and major wiring projects require an e-Permit from LADBS (Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety). AMY Electric handles all permits and inspections.
- **Why is a C-10 license required?**: In California, electrical work over $500 must be performed by a licensed C-10 electrical contractor. C-10 license #981578 ensures full insurance, bonding, and code compliance.
